items.q: A population is best defined as:
items.qAf: ’n Populasie word die beste omskryf as:
options: A group of individuals of the same species living in the same area at the same time
All the organisms in an ecosystem
Different species that share a habitat
The total biomass of a habitat
optionsAf: A group of individuals of the same species living in the same area at the same time
All the organisms in an ecosystem
Different species that share a habitat
The total biomass of a habitat
items.explain: Population criteria are the same species, the same place and the same time.
items.explainAf: Populasiekriteria is dieselfde spesie, dieselfde plek en dieselfde tyd.

options: Resources are unlimited
Predators are absent and resources are limited
The population has reached carrying capacity
The death rate is higher than the birth rate
optionsAf: Resources are unlimited
Predators are absent and resources are limited
The population has reached carrying capacity
The death rate is higher than the birth rate
items.explain: With unlimited resources the growth rate stays constant, so the population grows exponentially.
items.explainAf: Met onbeperkte hulpbronne bly die groeitempo konstant, dus groei die bevolking eksponensieel.

items.q: A population with limited resources follows logistic growth. What does it level off at?
items.qAf: ’n Bevolking met beperkte hulpbronne volg logistiese groei. Waarby vlak dit af?
options: Carrying capacity
Zero
The exponential phase
The birth rate
optionsAf: Carrying capacity
Zero
The exponential phase
The birth rate
items.explain: Growth slows as resources run short and the population stabilises near carrying capacity.
items.explainAf: Groei vertraag soos hulpbronne opraak en die bevolking stabiliseer naby draagvermoë.

items.q: The ecological niche of an organism includes:
items.qAf: Die ekologiese nis van ’n organisme sluit in:
options: Its role in the ecosystem, including habitat, food and interactions
Only the place where it lives
Only its body colour
Only its population size
optionsAf: Its role in the ecosystem, including habitat, food and interactions
Only the place where it lives
Only its body colour
Only its population size
items.explain: A niche is the full role of a species: where it lives, what it eats and how it interacts with others.
items.explainAf: ’n Nis is die volle rol van ’n spesie: waar dit leef, wat dit eet en hoe dit met ander interaksie het.

options: The time of day when an organism is active
The place where an organism lives
The type of food it eats
Its breeding season only
optionsAf: The time of day when an organism is active
The place where an organism lives
The type of food it eats
Its breeding season only
items.explain: Temporal niches separate species by the time they are active, for example day or night.
items.explainAf: Temporale nisse skei spesies volgens die tyd waarop hulle aktief is, byvoorbeeld dag of nag.

items.q: A herbivore population exceeds the carrying capacity of its habitat. What is the most likely result?
items.qAf: ’n Herbivoorbevolking oorskry die draagvermoë van sy habitat. Wat is die waarskynlikste gevolg?
options: Vegetation is depleted and the population later declines
Vegetation increases
The population stays stable
Predators disappear
optionsAf: Vegetation is depleted and the population later declines
Vegetation increases
The population stays stable
Predators disappear
items.explain: Overgrazing reduces food, so the herbivore population falls back to a level the habitat can support.
items.explainAf: Oorbeweiding verminder voedsel, sodat die herbivoorbevolking terugval tot ’n vlak wat die habitat kan dra.

items.q: An organism's role in its ecosystem, including what it eats and where it lives.
items.qAf: ’n Organisme se rol in sy ekosisteem, insluitend wat dit eet en waar dit woon.

items.q: Competition between different species for the same resource.
items.qAf: Kompetisie tussen verskillende spesies vir dieselfde hulpbron.

items.q: The gradual change in species composition of a community over time.
items.qAf: Die geleidelike verandering in die spesiesamestelling van ’n gemeenskap oor tyd.

items.q: The relationship in which one species benefits and the other is neither harmed nor helped.
items.qAf: Die verhouding waarin een spesie voordeel trek en die ander nóg benadeel nóg gehelp word.

items.text: The principle that two species cannot share exactly the same niche is called competitive [[]]. Species can share a habitat through resource [[]].
items.textAf: Die beginsel dat twee spesies nie presies dieselfde nis kan deel nie, word kompeterende [[]] genoem. Spesies kan ’n habitat deel deur hulpbron[[]].

items.q: Primary succession begins on bare rock where there was no soil.
items.qAf: Primêre suksessie begin op kaal rots waar daar geen grond was nie.
items.explain: True. Pioneer species such as lichens start to form soil.
items.explainAf: Waar. Pionierspesies soos ligene begin grond vorm.

items.q: The human population has stopped growing.
items.qAf: Die menslike bevolking het opgehou groei.
items.explain: False. The world population is still increasing, although the growth rate is slowing.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Die wêreldbevolking neem steeds toe, hoewel die groeitempo afneem.

items.q: A farmer keeps too many sheep on a farm. Explain the effect on the carrying capacity of the land.
items.qAf: ’n Boer hou te veel skape op ’n plaas aan. Verduidelik die uitwerking op die drakrag van die grond.
points: Plants die and soil erodes, so less food can grow.
The carrying capacity decreases (the land can support fewer animals).
pointsAf: Plante gaan dood en grond erodeer, dus kan minder kos groei.
Die drakrag neem af (die grond kan minder diere onderhou).
